summary: Fourteen selected items covering distinct AI stories: xAI Grok app-building, GPT-Image-2 transparent backgrounds, OpenAI Computer History EEA rollout, a karpathy analysis reply (with successful context summary), Palantir/data-retention policy report, two distinct MaxForAI Anthropic items (Computer Use launch, Claude Academy), gisting technique, DeepSeek v4 Flash adoption, an AI-watermark-stripping model, Hassabis rogue-AI warning, open-source Grok Bot, and a Reuters/UK-AISI malware report. No hard duplicates found. MaxForAI appears twice but on separate stories; flagged as overrepresented author for awareness. All special-account and reply items carry adequate self-contained or summarized context, so all are kept.
